title: Nouvelle Medina Station
summary: Urban train station in Casablanca whose folded, origami-like roof structures the building and modulates daylight.
tag: La nouvelle gare Nouvelle Medina / Plans, facades and sections / Scale 1:200

narrative.text: The architectural concept rests on a contemporary interpretation of origami, where the roof becomes a structuring element, both functional and expressive. Composed of dynamic folds, it generates a volume in tension that seems to unfold towards the public space, expressing the notion of movement inherent to travel.

This play of facets allows a subtle modulation of natural light through the interior spaces, while optimising rainwater runoff and solar protection. The glazed facade, in dialogue with this sculptural roof, ensures transparency and lightness, reinforcing the porosity between the city and the platforms. This architectural composition, both fluid and assertive, gives the station a strong identity, where structure and aesthetics merge in a dynamic balance.
